<div><span style="font-size:11pt">The proposed development, by reason of its scale, siting, design, bulk and mass would be an undesirable addition to the existing dwelling. <div><span style="font-size:11pt">The proposed development, by reason of its scale, siting and design would cause severe harm to the neighbouring occupiers.&nbsp; The proposed development fails to be appropriately setback from adjoining boundaries, and fails to mitigate any significant impact to the amenity of neighbouring dwellings.
